summary.text: Vivian Watts is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 14th District since 1996.
The district covers part of Fairfax County.
The House profile lists earlier service in 1982-85 and lists Vivian Watts as Minority Caucus Chief Policy Advisor (2011-).

paragraphs.text: Vivian Watts was born in Detroit, MI.
The profile lists a B.A., cum laude, from the University of Michigan (1962).
Vivian Watts's listed occupation is retired.
The profile lists the Arlington Unitarian Church, the Fairfax Area League of Women Voters (former president), the Salvation Army (board member) and the Annandale Rotary.
Vivian Watts serves on the Finance Committee (as chair), Rules, Courts of Justice and Transportation.
